Follow these simple steps to book your j: Follow these simple steps to book your journey with Bahir Dar Transportation System.
Enter your departure station and destina: Enter your departure station and destination on the 'Book Trip' page. Select your travel date to see available trips.
Browse the list of available trips. You: Browse the list of available trips. You can see the price, departure time, and remaining seats for each option.
Click on 'Choose Seats' and pick your pr: Click on 'Choose Seats' and pick your preferred spot from the interactive seat map. You can book multiple seats at once.
Choose your payment method. You can pay: Choose your payment method. You can pay securely online via Chapa or choose 'Pay at Station' to pay with cash.
Once confirmed, your ticket will appear: Once confirmed, your ticket will appear in 'My Bookings'. You can download or show it at the station when boarding.
Please arrive at the station at least 30: Please arrive at the station at least 30 minutes before departure. If you chose 'Pay at Station', ensure you complete your payment at least 1 hour before the trip starts to secure your seat.
